owner_action.reason: No owner-only decision is needed to reduce automatic spending and clarify reports. Existing services were not purchased or upgraded.

areas.title: Atlas & discovery
areas.text: Regional browsing exists. Full filters for purpose, rare dances, belief and solo/pair/group learning still need work.
areas.next: Check identities, origins and missing discovery fields.

areas.title: Culture, history & spirituality
areas.text: Source checks and restricted-teaching holds run. Community review and stronger evidence remain essential.
areas.next: Resolve conflicting claims and protect cultural restrictions.

areas.title: Active Profiles & teaching
areas.text: Per-dance research, timestamped video evidence, rights and human-review queues are being introduced. Scripts are supporting assets; no interactive classes are validated.
areas.next: Resolve concrete gaps within existing budgets and validate small, representative learning trials.

areas.title: BDF — AI guide and human friends
areas.text: The initial AI dance mentor connects learners with multiple consenting human BDFs matched by their stated musical and social preferences.
areas.next: Separate private preference memory, matching consent and human relationship controls from public dance knowledge.

areas.title: Languages & voices
areas.text: Native review, pronunciation and equivalent teaching still need validation.
areas.next: Review current translations before producing voices.

areas.title: Every age & ability
areas.text: Caregiver-led infancy, later-life adaptations and age protections are specified; suitable experiences are not validated.
areas.next: Validate age-specific and accessible teaching before release.

areas.title: Shared dance & belonging
areas.text: Split-screen, on-camera and optional future AR sessions need consent, moderation, accessibility and measured synchronization.
areas.next: Design shared practice, continuing groups and safe fallbacks when network delay prevents live synchronization.

areas.title: Viral dance culture
areas.text: The collection exists; ranking periods and refresh reliability need repair before popularity can be trusted.
areas.next: Use the verified database schema to repair ranking windows, missing observations and refresh within current limits.

areas.title: Create, collaborate & share
areas.text: Challenge practice, original dances, outfits, backgrounds, split screens and approved social exports are not implemented.
areas.next: Prepare reusable creative assets with credit and permission records.

areas.title: Credible, reusable music
areas.text: Musical references and briefs exist. Original tracks still need cultural review and documented reuse rights.
areas.next: Build tradition-specific musical tests and permissions before production.

areas.title: AR teachers & shared stages
areas.text: Glasses, nearby virtual dancers, stages and audiences are the destination; no validated experience is recorded.
areas.next: Evaluate spatial delivery after teaching and motion are reliable.

areas.title: Low costs & better technology
areas.text: Model API generation is paused by policy and workflow credentials removed. Bounded external research now runs weekly; existing hosting and subscription charges are unverified.
areas.next: Verify the next scheduled run, fix unchanged database writes and measure usage before authorizing any model allowance.

areas.title: Continuity across platforms
areas.text: The full vision and bounded research contract remain in GitHub. Prior research findings are preserved; mirrored publication must be verified separately.
areas.next: Keep this register and the platform ledger current after verified changes.

platform_observation.text: The correct Supabase project is accessible. Audit history uses about 541 MB; database usage exceeds the displayed free allowance. Review growth and retention before any purchase or deletion.
